mii.deadlineLabel: Quarterly application deadline for Technology Assessment (up to $180K joint/$130K sole) and Company Formation (up to $300K)
mii.notes: Deadlines are quarterly: Jan 15, Apr 15, Jul 15, Oct 15. Applications must be submitted by 5:00pm. Two funding phases: Technology Assessment (9 months, up to $130-180K) and Company Formation (9 months, up to $300K). Applicants must engage with a Site Miner at least 30 days before submission.

mii_joint.deadlineLabel: Technology Assessment (Joint USM Track) - Quarterly submission deadline
mii_joint.notes: MII operates on quarterly deadlines. Joint applications between two Qualifying Universities can receive up to $180,000 for Technology Assessment phase. Site Miner engagement required 30 days before submission.

mii_cf.deadlineLabel: Q4 Application Deadline - Company Formation track (5:00pm EST)
mii_cf.notes: MII follows quarterly submission deadlines (Jan 15, Apr 15, Jul 15, Oct 15). Company Formation phase supports commercial launch for start-ups licensed from Qualifying Universities. Applicants must engage with a Site Miner at least 30 days before submission.

bii.notes: Most recent cycle closed May 20, 2026. BII follows annual RFA timeline with Indication of Interest (IOI) stage first. Next cycle expected Spring 2027. Program requires meeting with onsite Project Lead at least 30 days before submission.

mscrf.deadlineLabel: Summer 2026 funding cycle submission deadline (passed June 23, 2026). Next cycle expected mid-July 2026 with details TBA.
mscrf.notes: The June 23, 2026 submission deadline has passed as of the current date (July 1, 2026). MSCRF operates multiple funding cycles throughout the year with mid-January and mid-July deadlines for most programs. Specific details for the next cycle are not yet published on the website.

builder.deadlineLabel: Rolling admissions - applications accepted on an ongoing basis through online portal
builder.notes: Pre-Seed Builder Fund is part of TEDCO's Social Impact Funds. Program is active as of July 2026. Investments typically $100,000 via convertible notes. Requires at least 50% founder economic disadvantage and Maryland operations.

inclusion.deadlineLabel: Rolling equity fund — applications assessed on an ongoing basis
inclusion.notes: Inclusion Fund is part of TEDCO's Social Impact Funds portfolio. Supports early-stage technology startups with at least 30% ownership by individuals demonstrating social and economic disadvantage. Applications must be submitted online through TEDCO's website.

aha.deadlineLabel: Predoctoral Fellowship proposal deadline (earliest mechanism); Additional deadlines: Postdoctoral Fellowship (Aug 5), Institutional Award for Undergraduates (Sep 9), AIREA (Sep 10), Career Development Award (Dec 1)
aha.notes: AHA offers multiple funding mechanisms with rolling deadlines throughout 2026. All listed mechanisms are currently open. Full proposals for some programs require pre-proposals. Check individual program pages for eligibility and submission details.

mjff.deadlineLabel: Parkinson's Disease Proteoforms Program (Full Proposal). Multiple other programs with rolling deadlines and fixed dates through July 22, 2026.
mjff.notes: MJFF maintains multiple concurrent funding programs. Open programs include: (1) Bridge Funding for Disrupted Neurodegenerative Research - Rolling; (2) Parkinson's Disease Proteoforms Program - July 21, 2026; (3) GBA1 Parkinson's Disease Research Catalyst Program - July 22, 2026 (Full Proposals); (4) Parkinson's Disease Therapeutics Pipeline Program - Rolling. Several other programs listed as 'Programs in Review' with past pre-proposal deadlines. Founders should check the full funding page for all active opportunities.
